tasks.label: Setup dev environment
tasks.detail: Create env files, install pnpm + uv deps, build the toolkit

tasks.label: Dev: agent
tasks.detail: UDIAgent FastAPI server (http://localhost:8007). Includes the duckdb/starrocks drivers and reads UDI_QUERY_BACKENDS from packages/agent/.env, which the seed scripts set — so this one task serves both browser mode and server-side (remote) mode.
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra server --extra duckdb --extra starrocks fastapi dev packages/agent/src/udiagent/server/app.py --port 8007 --reload-dir packages/agent/src --reload-dir packages/grammar-py/src

tasks.label: Dev: chat + agent
tasks.detail: Start the core dev stack (chat SPA + agent server) together

tasks.label: Data: Start StarRocks
tasks.detail: docker compose up the local StarRocks container (idempotent; ~30-60s to become healthy)

tasks.label: Data: Generate pcx datapackage
tasks.detail: Regenerate sample-data/pcx/datapackage.json from the CSVs (stdlib only). For another dataset, run scripts/gen_datapackage.py directly.

tasks.label: Data: Seed StarRocks (pcx)
tasks.detail: Load sample-data/pcx into StarRocks as package `pcx` and write packages/agent/starrocks-backends.json (waits for the container to be ready)
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra starrocks python packages/agent/scripts/seed_starrocks.py sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Regenerate + seed pcx
tasks.detail: Start StarRocks, regenerate the pcx datapackage, then seed the database — one-click refresh after editing sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Seed DuckDB (pcx)
tasks.detail: Seed sample-data/pcx into a local packages/agent/pcx.duckdb file as package `pcx` + merge into duckdb-backends.json — no container needed. Stop the agent before re-seeding.
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra duckdb python packages/agent/scripts/seed_duckdb.py sample-data/pcx

tasks.label: Data: Regenerate + seed pcx (DuckDB)
tasks.detail: Regenerate the pcx datapackage, then seed a local DuckDB file — zero-infrastructure alternative to StarRocks (no Docker)

tasks.label: Data: Use penguins (remote/DuckDB)
tasks.detail: One-click server-side (remote) setup with the bundled penguins package: seed it into a local packages/agent/penguins.duckdb (+ duckdb-backends.json) and point the chat at it (VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE=penguins). Then run 'Dev: chat + agent'. Stop the agent before re-seeding.
tasks.command: uv run --project packages/agent --extra duckdb python packages/agent/scripts/seed_duckdb.py && node scripts/set-chat-data-source.mjs penguins --remote

tasks.label: Data: Use pcx (remote/DuckDB)
tasks.detail: Switch the chat to pcx in server-side mode on DuckDB: seed sample-data/pcx into packages/agent/pcx.duckdb (+ duckdb-backends.json), then set VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE=pcx. Then run 'Dev: chat + agent'. Stop the agent before re-seeding.

tasks.label: Data: Use pcx (remote/StarRocks)
tasks.detail: Switch the chat to pcx in server-side mode on StarRocks: start the container, seed sample-data/pcx (+ starrocks-backends.json), then set VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE=pcx. Then run 'Dev: chat + agent (remote/StarRocks)'.

tasks.label: Data: Point chat at pcx (remote, no re-seed)
tasks.detail: Just flip packages/chat/.env.local to VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE=pcx, without touching the database — for switching back to an already-seeded pcx. Restart the agent and chat dev servers after.

tasks.label: Data: Use HuBMAP (CSV, browser mode)
tasks.detail: Reset the chat to the bundled HuBMAP CSV dumps in interactive (browser) mode — points VITE_UDI_DATA_PACKAGE at /data/hubmap and disables VITE_UDI_REMOTE_PACKAGE in packages/chat/.env.local. Restart the agent and chat dev servers after. (The underlying script takes a package arg, e.g. `pcx`, for other bundled sources.)
